text.zh: 他的求学生涯始于他所住的伦敦附近的儿童之家。
text.en: His schooling began at the children's home near London where he lived.

text.zh: 父母已离婚，他被留给父亲抚养。
text.en: His parents had divorced and he had been left with his father.

text.zh: 住在米德尔塞克斯郡特威克纳姆的慈善儿童之家（Shaftesbury Homes）。
text.en: Lives in a charity-supported Shaftesbury Homes children's home in Twickenham, Middlesex.

text.zh: 他说不想结婚，因为老婆可能会逼他吃青菜。
text.en: Says he wouldn't want to marry, because a wife might make him eat greens.

text.zh: 尚未决定职业，曾考虑当银行会计、汽车钣金工和体育老师。
text.en: Undecided about a career; he had considered bank accountant, panel beater and PE teacher.

text.zh: 和父亲及继母一起生活，他们已移民澳大利亚。
text.en: Lives with his father and stepmother, who had emigrated to Australia.

text.zh: 住在澳大利亚墨尔本一带。
text.en: Lives in the Melbourne area of Australia.

text.zh: 八岁随家人移民澳大利亚，起初住在当地一家儿童之家。
text.en: Emigrated to Australia with his family at eight, at first living in a children's home there.

text.zh: 觉得在儿童之家时某种程度上更快乐，那里人人是朋友，但也乐于住在家里。
text.en: Feels he was happier in a way at the home, where everyone was a friend, but is glad to be home.

text.zh: 砌砖工，去年六月成为所在公司的初级合伙人。
text.en: Bricklayer; he was made a junior partner in his firm the previous June.

text.zh: 有女友 Sue（后来成为他的妻子）；他与父亲和继母都不亲近。
text.en: Has a girlfriend, Sue, whom he later married; he is not close to his father or stepmother.

text.zh: 住在澳大利亚墨尔本一带。
text.en: Lives in the Melbourne area, Australia.

text.zh: 到伦敦时与 Symon 重访昔日的儿童之家；21 岁时，此前从无联系的母亲来看他。
text.en: Visiting London, he toured his old children's home with Symon; at 21 his mother, out of contact until then, visited him.

text.zh: 他说一切开始好转，他不再觉得自己是个没希望的人。
text.en: Says things have started to come good and he no longer sees himself as a no-hoper.

text.zh: 他说自己上学时很懒，不够用功。
text.en: Says he was lazy and didn't work hard enough at school.

text.zh: 砌砖工；曾自立门户当分包商，后来与人合伙，但没有成功。
text.en: Bricklayer; he went out on his own as a subcontractor, then took a partner, which didn't work out.

text.zh: 与兼职理发师 Susan 结婚，育有 Katie 和 Robert 两个孩子。
text.en: Married to Susan, a part-time hairdresser; they have two children, Katie and Robert.

text.zh: 住在墨尔本一个工人阶级郊区，房子是 18 个月前买的。
text.en: Lives in a working-class suburb of Melbourne, in a house bought 18 months earlier.

text.zh: 与 Sue 结婚并生了两个孩子；四年前两人开旧货车环游澳大利亚七个月。
text.en: Married Sue and had two children; four years earlier the couple spent seven months touring Australia in a van.

text.zh: 他认为砌砖大概会是自己一辈子的工作，尽管并非所愿。
text.en: Expects bricklaying to be his job for life, though not by choice.

text.zh: 他说自己从没受过商业培训，更像手艺人而非生意人。
text.en: Says he has never had any business training and is more a tradesperson than a businessman.

text.zh: 分包生意失败后，他在建筑行业做过多份工作。
text.en: Has had a variety of building-trade jobs since his subcontracting venture didn't work out.

text.zh: 与 Sue 结婚约 13 年，育有 Katy 和 Robert 两个孩子。
text.en: Married to Sue for about 13 years; they have two children, Katy and Robert.

text.zh: 住在墨尔本一个工人阶级郊区。
text.en: Lives in a working-class suburb of Melbourne.

text.zh: 带 Sue、Katy 和 Robert 去英国，首次探望那边的家人。
text.en: Brought Sue, Katy and Robert to England to visit his family there for the first time.

text.zh: 他希望与孩子有更多亲密的身体接触，而不像他和父亲那样。
text.en: Wants more close physical contact with his children than he had with his own father.

text.zh: 两三年前他重返学校，考取了木工证书。
text.en: Two or three years earlier he went back to school and took a carpentry certificate.

text.zh: 在一家塑料公司安装工业标牌；离开砌砖行业后换过十到十五份工作。
text.en: Installs industrial signs for a plastics company, after 10 to 15 jobs since bricklaying.

text.zh: 与 Sue 结婚 20 年，孩子是 Katy 和 Robert。
text.en: Married to Sue for 20 years; their children are Katy and Robert.

text.zh: 住在墨尔本另一个郊区，新房几乎是旧房的两倍大。
text.en: Lives in another Melbourne suburb, in a house nearly twice the size of the old one.

text.zh: 年初还清旧房贷款后搬家；迎来结婚 20 周年。
text.en: Moved house early in the year after paying off the old one; marked 20 years of marriage.

text.zh: 他说自己学会了与缺乏自信共处，但始终没能完全克服。
text.en: Says he has learned to live with his lack of confidence but never fully overcome it.

text.zh: 仍在工厂制作标牌，已干了十年，担心以自己的技能难找全职工作。
text.en: Still in his factory job making signs, ten years in, and worried about finding full-time work at his skill level.

text.zh: 与 Sue 仍是夫妻；Katy 考上大学读考古，Robert 学成汽车修理工；已有两个孙辈。
text.en: Married to Sue; Katy got a place at university to study archaeology, Robert has trained as a car mechanic, and they have two grandchildren.

text.zh: 住在澳大利亚墨尔本一带。
text.en: Lives in Australia, in the Melbourne area.

text.zh: 工作问题打击了自尊，他求助于医生；被请回英国与 Symon 重聚。
text.en: Saw a doctor for help after problems at work lowered his self-esteem; flown to England to reunite with Symon.

text.zh: 他说自己已没什么抱负，如今靠跑步获得内心平静。
text.en: Says he no longer really has ambitions, and now finds his peace through running.

text.zh: 在一家退休村做维修和杂活，Susan 也在那里工作。
text.en: Does maintenance and odd jobs at a retirement village where Susan also works.

text.zh: 与 Susan 仍是夫妻；Katie 上过大学；Robert 夫妇有五个孩子。
text.en: Married to Susan; Katie went to university, and Robert and his wife Stacey have five children.

text.zh: 住在澳大利亚墨尔本一带。
text.en: Lives in the Melbourne area, Australia.

text.zh: 开始在 Susan 工作的退休村做维修；夫妇俩曾去约克郡看望 Katie。
text.en: Started a maintenance job at the retirement village where Susan works; the couple visited Katie in Yorkshire.

text.zh: 夫妇俩认为，至今仍相守、未遭不幸就是成功。
text.en: The couple count it a success that they are still together and have been spared tragedy.

text.zh: 与 Susan 结婚 40 年，有六个孙辈；女儿 Katie 是教师，已有伴侣。
text.en: Married to Susan for 40 years; six grandchildren; daughter Katie is a schoolteacher with a partner.

text.zh: 住在澳大利亚墨尔本一带，Symon 夫妇来此与他共度圣诞。
text.en: Lives in the Melbourne area, Australia, where Symon and Vienetta came to spend Christmas.

text.zh: 父亲约四年前去世；第六个孙辈 Brody 出生；Symon 夫妇从英国来访。
text.en: His father died about four years earlier; a sixth grandchild, Brody, arrived; Symon and Vienetta visited from England.

text.zh: 他认为人生不该有遗憾，庆幸遇到 Susan，只是或许想多要几个孩子。
text.en: Sees no place for regrets and feels lucky to have met Susan, though he might have liked more children.

text.zh: 与 Sue 结婚四十多年仍相守；已有了孙辈，很疼爱他们。
text.en: Still married to Sue after more than four decades; a grandfather who dotes on his grandchildren.

text.zh: 住在澳大利亚。
text.en: Lives in Australia.

text.zh: 住在澳大利亚，结婚四十多年仍与妻子相守，已有了孙辈，称家庭是“百分之百最重要的事”。
text.en: Lives in Australia, still married after more than four decades, and is a grandfather who says family is "100% the main thing".
